rows.grounds: bahuvrīhi/tatpuruṣa compound qualifying dhūmāvatīm; ḍākinī = attendant female spirits, bhoga = enjoyment, santuṣṭa = satisfied
verb of devotion addressed to the goddess
name of the mahāvidyā goddess, object of worship

items.question: What satisfaction characterizes Dhūmāvatī as the object of the speaker's worship?
premises: The speaker declares worship of Dhūmāvatī.
Dhūmāvatī is described as satisfied with the enjoyment of ḍākinīs.
This satisfaction qualifies the goddess being worshipped.
items.inference: Dhūmāvatī is worshipped as one satisfied with the enjoyment of ḍākinīs.
items.plain_english: I worship Dhūmāvatī, who is satisfied with the enjoyment of the ḍākinīs.
